text_block_list.text:
A few days after the athletic festival—
I noticed a lively commotion gathered at one corner of the training course.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Goal!

Taking a closer look, it seemed the horsegirls were competing in a mock race.
Way behind the girl who had just crossed the finish line was...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whew... whew... Mmm-goooaaal!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Haa... haah... Aww, I lost...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Urara-chan.
That was really fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch for racing with me too!
Next time, I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All right, who should I race next~?!
...Wait, huh? Trainer!
choice_data_list: Were you having a mock race?
Were you doing a mock race?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: This isn't just a mock race, it's a "Dojo Buster" challenge!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I saw it in a manga yesterday! You yell "I challenge you!" and then
go around knocking down super strong people one after another!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The manga said "This is the path to true strength!",
so I decided to try it out too!
choice_data_list: Looked more like you were the one getting knocked down...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But I think I can win next time!
I've just got this feeling, you know!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Now then, back to my Dojo Busting!
My next opponent is...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Spe-chan!
Speeeee-chaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Urara-chan!
Are you out here training too?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I came up with brand-new training!
Spe-chan, I challenge you to a duel!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? A duel...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: A race, a race! Let's run together, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait, what? Huh?
And so, Haru Urara's "Dojo Busting" resumed once more, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew... Goal!
A good while after Special Week crossed the finish line...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Gasp... whew... Goooaaalll...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so done foooor...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aahh?! Urara-chan?!

Even with such a massive gap, Haru Urara had given it everything she had
all the way to the end, collapsing right onto the ground.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Phew~, I almost passed out right there!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You didn't almost pass out, you literally collapsed...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm totally fine now, though! I got plenty of rest!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, you're seriously awesome.
I'd expect nothing less from the rival I picked out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Next time, I definitely won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Watching you zoom-zoom-zoom ahead like that
made me feel like I can do it too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's race again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All righty, who should I Dojo Bust next~?
I challenge you! I challenge youuu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... and there she goes...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Urara-chan really is incredible, isn't she?
No matter what happens, she's always so full of energy and cheerful.
choice_data_list: She's always looking on the bright side.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She really is! Whenever I lose a race,
I get so down on myself and think I'm no good...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But watching how positive Urara-chan is,
it fills me with the energy to keep giving it my best too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm going to follow Urara-chan's lead and give my training everything I've got!

Whether in the athletic festival or in her "Dojo Busting,"
Haru Urara kept running with a smile no matter how many times she lost.
Her earnest determination seemed to touch everyone around her.
